name: agent-bridge
description: Send prompts into your IDE's AI agent chat by dropping a file in a folder. Works with Antigravity and VS Code chat.
author: alokkkchaudharyyy

untrustedWorkspaces.description: onDoneCommand is disabled in untrusted workspaces.

agentBridge.inboxPath.markdownDescription: Folder to watch for prompts. Empty = `<workspace>/.agent-inbox`. Relative paths are resolved against the first workspace folder.

agentBridge.pollIntervalMs.markdownDescription: How often to check the inbox folder for new prompt files (in milliseconds). Minimum is 1000.

agentBridge.confirmBeforeSend.markdownDescription: Ask before sending each prompt. **Keep this on** unless you trust everything that can write to the inbox.

agentBridge.newConversationMarker.markdownDescription: If a prompt file starts with this, a new agent conversation is started first. Empty = disabled.

agentBridge.lessonsFile.markdownDescription: Lessons file (relative to the workspace or absolute) that reviewers append mistakes to.

enumDescriptions: Append one line asking the agent to read the lessons file
Paste the newest lessons into each prompt (max ~4000 chars)
agentBridge.lessonsMode.markdownDescription: How to include review lessons in prompts sent to the agent.

agentBridge.completionSignal.markdownDescription: Append a footer asking the agent to write `done/<id>.json` (or `question/<id>.md`) when it finishes, so scripts know when it's done.

agentBridge.stuckAfterMinutes.markdownDescription: Warn if no done/question file arrives within this many minutes. 0 = never.

agentBridge.onDoneCommand.markdownDescription: Optional shell command run when a task finishes, asks a question, or looks stuck. Details arrive as env vars: `AGENT_BRIDGE_EVENT`, `AGENT_BRIDGE_ID`, `AGENT_BRIDGE_STATUS`, `AGENT_BRIDGE_FILE`, `AGENT_BRIDGE_SUMMARY`, `AGENT_BRIDGE_INBOX`. Only read from user settings; disabled in untrusted workspaces.
